title: Few-shot Classification as Multi-instance Verification: Effective Backbone-agnostic Transfer across Domains
abstract: arXiv:2507.00401v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate cross-domain few-shot learning under the constraint that fine-tuning of backbones (i.e., feature extractors) is impossible or infeasible---a scenario that is increasingly common in practical use cases---and show how representing few-shot classification as a series of multiple instance verification (MIV) tasks enables competitive classification performance using the static embeddings produced by frozen, "black-box" backbones. More specifically, based on this novel representation, we introduce a new approach to few-shot domain adaptation named the "MIV-head": a classification head that is backbone-agnostic and computationally efficient. We show that the core components of the MIV-head, when trained on few-shot data from a target domain, collectively yield strong performance on test data from that domain. Importantly, they do so without fine-tuning the backbone, requiring only the "meta-testing" phase. In experiment

translated_title: 将少样本分类视为多实例验证：跨域的高效骨干网络无关迁移
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在无法或不适合对骨干网络（即特征提取器）进行微调的约束下的跨域少样本学习——这种情况在实际应用场景中越来越常见——并展示了如何将少样本分类表示为一系列多实例验证（MIV）任务，从而利用冻结的“黑盒”骨干网络所产生的静态嵌入实现有竞争力的分类性能。更具体地说，基于这种新颖的表示方法，我们提出了一种名为“MIV-head”的少样本域适应新方法：一个与骨干网络无关且计算高效的分类头。我们表明，当在来自目标域的少样本数据上进行训练时，MIV-head的核心组件共同在该域的测试数据上产生了强大的性能。重要的是，它们无需对骨干网络进行微调即可实现这一点，只需要“元测试”阶段。
tldr: 提出将少样本分类转化为多实例验证任务的"MIV-head"分类头，在无法微调骨干网络的约束下，仅利用冻结“黑盒”骨干网络的静态嵌入即可在目标域少样本数据上训练并实现有竞争力的跨域分类性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes the "MIV-head", a backbone-agnostic and computationally efficient classification head that recasts few-shot classification as multiple instance verification tasks, enabling competitive cross-domain few-shot classification using static embeddings from frozen "black-box" backbones without any fine-tuning.
